{{- /* The first lines of every Markdown version: a pointer to the docs index, the title, the description as a blockquote, and the API reference pages a guide documents (its `api_symbols`, the chip row above the HTML title), each linked to its Markdown version. The pointer is what Anthropic's Claude Code docs put on top of each page's Markdown: an agent that lands on one page (from a search, or a link someone pasted) learns where the index of all the others is. The index is the home page's llms.txt output, whatever the site named the format (gdc-ui `LLMS`, the theme's own `LLM_TXT`); with neither, the pointer is left out. Expects: the page. Returns the Markdown string. */ -}} {{- $index := "" -}} {{- range slice "llms" "llm_txt" -}} {{- with site.Home.OutputFormats.Get . -}} {{- if not $index }}{{ $index = .Permalink }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $blocks := slice -}} {{- with $index }}{{ $blocks = $blocks | append (printf "> Documentation index: %s lists every page of these docs as Markdown." .) }}{{ end -}} {{- $blocks = $blocks | append (printf "# %s" .Title) -}} {{- with .Description }}{{ $blocks = $blocks | append (printf "> %s" .) }}{{ end -}} {{- $symbols := slice -}} {{- range partial "api-symbol-links.html" . -}} {{- $url := .page.Permalink -}} {{- with .page.OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ $url = .Permalink }}{{ end -}} {{- $note := slice -}} {{- with .entry.kind }}{{ $note = $note | append . }}{{ end -}} {{- with .entry.stability }}{{ $note = $note | append . }}{{ end -}} {{- if .entry.deprecated }}{{ $note = $note | append "deprecated" }}{{ end -}} {{- $symbols = $symbols | append (printf "[%s](%s)%s" .entry.title $url (cond (gt (len $note) 0) (printf " (%s)" (delimit $note ", ")) "")) -}} {{- end -}} {{- with $symbols }}{{ $blocks = $blocks | append (printf "API reference: %s" (delimit . ", ")) }}{{ end -}} {{- return delimit $blocks "\n\n" -}}
